claims: The 2026 MLB season officially opens on Wednesday, March 25.
There is a standalone "Opening Night" game between the New York Yankees and San Francisco Giants at Oracle Park.
The Opening Night game streams on Netflix.
The Opening Night game is at 8:05 p.m. ET.
Traditional Opening Day is on Thursday, March 26.
Opening Day features a 14-game slate including the Dodgers and Tigers.
The Dodgers start their season on March 26.
The Athletics begin their season on March 27.
The Blue Jays begin their season on March 27.
The Braves begin their season on March 27.
The Marlins begin their season on March 27.
The Rockies begin their season on March 27.
The Royals begin their season on March 27.
